items.title: Grafana Assistant Expands to More Than 30 Data Sources
items.summaryShort: Grafana Assistant Expands to More Than 30 Data Sources. Grafana Labs has expanded the capabilities of Grafana Assistant, enabling its AI-powered observability assistant to query and correlate data across more than 30 different data sources

items.title: Presentation: The Future of Engineering: Mindsets That Matter When Code Isn’t Enough
items.summaryShort: Presentation: The Future of Engineering: Mindsets That Matter When Code Isn’t Enough. Ben Greene discusses how software engineers can adapt and thrive in an era of rapid AI code automation.

items.title: Remix 3 Beta Preview Ditches React for a Web-Standards Full-Stack Framework
items.summaryShort: Remix 3 Beta Preview Ditches React for a Web-Standards Full-Stack Framework. Remix 3 is a full-stack web framework that moves away from React, focusing on web platform primitives.

items.title: Article: The Hard-Stop Rule: From 3 HCM Monoliths to 120 Domain Microservices
items.summaryShort: Article: The Hard-Stop Rule: From 3 HCM Monoliths to 120 Domain Microservices. A payroll and HR software team rebuilt three monoliths into over 120 smaller services over five years, with no dedicated migration budget.

items.title: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents
items.summaryShort: Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security for $1B to safeguard proliferating AI agents. The deal is Cyera's third acquisition this year.

items.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight
items.summaryShort: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight. Spur Intelligence has raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its tech that can identify legit human traffic from bots.

items.title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea
items.summaryShort: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea. Runlayer is suing Rippling after Rippling evaluated the startup's MCP gateway product and then opted to build one itself.
